headline: Top AI PhD graduates from China's leading universities are earning multi-million-yuan pay packages.
score_reason: Pool 5; read in full; the pay figures come from interviews, so no raise or lowering.
importance_line: Pay for top AI researchers is rising sharply, which matters most to graduates and junior programmers first, and the doubt is that the pay figures come from interviews rather than a published survey.
summary: Yicai reports that salaries for AI PhD graduates from Peking University and Tsinghua University are climbing, with packages of several million yuan a year at big technology firms such as ByteDance. Yang Ling, an assistant professor at Peking University, says only the top tier of AI talent will stay critical and expects the talent shortage to ease over the next five years.
